rows.label: bf02290100_0020
rows.name:
Just because she's in His Majesty's good graces,
that vixen thinks she can order me around-

rows.label: bf02290100_0030
rows.name: If I could obtain Heaven's Holy Grail...

rows.label: bf02290100_0040
rows.name:
I could have returned home in triumph,
or sold her to Bahn for a tidy sum...

rows.label: bf02290100_0050
rows.name:
But it's not over. I refuse to
let this place be the end of me!

rows.label: bf02290100_0060
rows.name:
I won't end up as some consul
in a backwater that reeks of beasts.

rows.label: bf02290100_0090
rows.name:
Double the number of guards. If that's not enough,
gather more from around the city.

rows.label: bf02290100_0100
rows.name:
We'll obtain Heaven's Holy Grail before Meleph.
Understood?
